The finite count follows from a bijective discriminant parameter. value.rationale: This is the structural completion of a naturally motivated first width-two example in quandle algebras. Rather than a small numerical adjustment, it gives an exact membership criterion for the non-linear commutator map over all characteristic-five fields and counts its arithmetic failure locus over every finite extension. The Pluecker square obstruction sharply distinguishes square-closed and other fields, supplying a reusable geometric diagnostic for algebraic commutator image questions.
